layout_dets.text: 3.2.3. Isolation and Interception

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The basic coeffect context Σ models a flat dependency table. In practice, however, the system

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: may need to bind distinct values to the same logical dependency for different components.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This section extends the coeffect context with two mechanisms: coeffect isolation (the same key

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resolves differently in different contexts) and coeffect interception (cross-cutting behavior on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dependency access).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Realization. The two mechanisms differ from get and set in what they act on. A provision

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: writes the shared table every component reads, so it is an effect on that table and carries an

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: inverse to withdraw it. Isolation and interception instead adjust how a key is resolved for the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: components under one context, leaving the table itself as it stands. Typing an operation as an

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: effect fixes its denotation, a successor state paired with an inverse, but not its realization, which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: determines how that inverse is carried out.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Definition 23. An effect function on a context admits two realizations:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: aliases the input, and recovery runs the inverse to undo the mutation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with the identity as its inverse; recovery discards the derived context. A context derived

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from another is what the recursive structure of Definition 28 carries.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: one, so each is typed below as a map from context to context rather than as an effect function.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lift, and recovery discards the derived context along with the adjustment it carried. Assignment

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on a derived table overrides whatever the inherited table held at the key, which is why neither

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: operation carries a precondition.
